Option A is the more likely relationship. I answered from what I know of this dataset (it looks like the Sachs et al. flow cytometry data) and did not run any analysis on `flow.csv`.

In the known signalling network, PKC acts upstream of Raf, Mek and PKA. Those lead on to Erk, which is p44/42. So PKC influences p44/42, mostly through intermediate proteins, and p44/42 does not act back on PKC.

ANSWER: A
